##### Project general facts

Samana Ocean Bay is a luxurious waterfront sanctuary, where modern architecture and the natural rhythm of the sea come together in perfect harmony. Inspired by the flow of waves and the openness of the sky, the building's curvilinear form, luminous façade, and coastal textures create a serene visual language that transforms everyday life into a resort-inspired experience. More than a residence, Ocean Bay is a retreat that captures the essence of island elegance in the heart of Dubai.

Ocean Bay delivers a lifestyle centered on wellness and leisure. Residents enjoy a fully equipped gym, outdoor workout spaces, meditation zones, a zen garden, a steam room, and lush green spaces designed for rejuvenation. A dramatic infinity-edge main pool, splash pads, a kids' pool, and outdoor playgrounds ensure fun for all ages. With its privileged location and curated comforts, every moment is framed by sea, sky, and absolute serenity.

Every residence at Samana Ocean Bay is thoughtfully designed to offer maximum light, space, and tranquility. Expansive floor plans with high ceilings, large windows, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions invite panoramic water views into every room. Interiors are crafted with premium materials, curated color palettes, and refined finishes, balancing luxurious aesthetics with day-to-day comfort. Private infinity pools, spa-like bathrooms, and soft ambient lighting further elevate the living experience. Kitchens are fully equipped with Bosch appliances, and apartments are semi-furnished, creating a canvas for personal expression within a space of absolute serenity.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Central Island within the visionary Dubai Islands development, this exceptional location epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. The collection of five man-made islands offers a unique living experience surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters, providing a tranquil escape from the bustling city.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and world-class amenities. Seamless access to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure places residents just a short drive from Dubai's iconic landmarks and vibrant districts, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development features luxury hotels, gourmet dining, high-end retail, and world-class recreational facilities, creating a self-sufficient waterfront community.

For those seeking a residence that embodies island elegance, modern innovation, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Islands delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, cutting-edge amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of the world's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of waterfront living — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the heart of the city.
